title.zh: Barrier问题，靠一项量测抓不住
title.en: A single measurement cannot capture barrier problems

subtitle.zh: 截面、电阻与可靠性必须互相印证，最后回到SPC
subtitle.en: Cross-sections, resistance and reliability must corroborate each other and feed back to SPC

body.zh: 结构证据；顶部liner厚度；侧壁liner厚度；50 nm；底部liner厚度
body.en: Structural evidence Top liner thickness Sidewall liner thickness 50 nm Bottom liner thickness

body.zh: 膜厚与Step Coverage；连续性 / 针孔 / 界面；Seam / Void位置
body.en: Film thickness and step coverage Continuity / pinholes / interfaces Seam / void location

body.zh: 回答：缺陷在哪里？
body.en: Answers: Where is the defect?

body.zh: 电性证据；Contact-chain；Via-chain
body.en: Electrical evidence Contact chain Via chain

body.zh: 电阻分布；电阻（Ω）
body.en: Resistance distribution Resistance (Ω)

body.zh: Contact R / Via R；Line R / Sheet R；Leakage
body.en: Contact R / via R Line R / sheet R Leakage

body.zh: 回答：电流路径是否异常？
body.en: Answers: Is the current path abnormal?

body.zh: 3；可靠性证据；TDDB （Cu）；EM （Cu）
body.en: 3 Reliability evidence TDDB (Cu) EM (Cu)

body.zh: 温度应力；Cu：TDDB / EM；W：接触稳定性 / 热应力；电流应力；失效分布与寿命
body.en: Thermal stress Cu: TDDB / EM W: contact stability / thermal stress Current stress; failure distribution and lifetime

body.zh: 回答：异常会不会随时间放大？
body.en: Answers: Will the anomaly amplify over time?

body.zh: 4；SPC反馈；Wafer Map（指标）；Tool / Chamber分层；High；Chamber；均值（指标）；A；Low；B；C
body.en: 4 SPC feedback Wafer map (metric) Tool / chamber stratification High Chamber Mean (metric) A Low B C

body.zh: Run-to-Run趋势；UCL；CL；LCL；Run #（时间顺序）
body.en: Run-to-run trend UCL CL LCL Run # (time order)

body.zh: 回答：异常从哪里开始漂移？
body.en: Answers: Where did the drift begin?

body.zh: Barrier闭环；结构|电性；可靠性 | 制程
body.en: Barrier feedback loop Structure | electrical behavior Reliability | process

body.zh: 结构异常；+ 电性异常；锁定失效机制；DOE/ Split验证；更新控制计划
body.en: Structural anomaly + electrical anomaly Identify the failure mechanism DOE / split validation Update the control plan

body.zh: 不要看到单点超规就直接改Recipe；先建立跨量测证据链
body.en: Do not change the recipe directly after a single out-of-spec point; first establish evidence across measurements

body.zh: 量测不是终点，能反馈到制程窗口才叫闭环
body.en: Measurement closes the loop only when it feeds back into the process window

body.zh: 频数
body.en: Frequency

body.zh: 指标
body.en: Metric

body.zh: 电流（A）
body.en: Current (A)

body.zh: 电阻变化（%）
body.en: Resistance change (%)

notes.zh: 图中TDDB/EM曲线有标注坐标，但没有提供原始数据或实验条件；作为源图示意保留，不当作实测结果。
notes.en: TDDB/EM plots have labeled scales but no underlying data or experimental conditions; preserve them as source schematics, not measured results.
